found_by: checker (b2-admission-denied follow-up, from a separate code review; confirmed by reading the code)
title: settleDeniedCapture rewrites the capture status to failed unconditionally and may remove the zero-byte file after a stop() that threw for another reason
evidence: packages/meeting-bot/src/capture/admission-gate.ts:88-98 calls writeOwnedTabStatus(state failed, error = admission_denied message) with no read of the prior state, and rmSync at :91 runs whenever size is 0. tab-browser.ts:278 already writes state failed with run.failure or run.recovered (for example 'Owned capture child shutdown unconfirmed; lock retained', 'Capture control evidence could not be persisted'); settleDeniedCapture is called from record-commands.ts:205 (finally, also when stop() threw) and overwrites that evidence. If shutdown was unconfirmed the child may still hold the file, and on POSIX the unlink succeeds. No media bytes are at risk when size is 0, so it is evidence loss plus a narrow race, not a media loss. Not covered by any B2 criterion.
fix_direction: read the prior status first; rewrite only when its state is stopped or starting (keep an existing failed message); skip the zero-byte removal when stop() threw anything other than 'Tab capture produced no media bytes'. Verify inside the next unit that touches admission-gate.ts (medium: one-line ledger, no unit of its own).

found_by: checker (b2-admission-denied follow-up, from a separate code review; confirmed by reading the code)
title: A control stop request in the same controller tick as admission_denied skips the captureFailure throw, so runRecord does not reject with admission_denied
evidence: packages/meeting-bot/src/capture/record-commands.ts:189-190: the loop checks `if (stop) {... break;}` before `if (captureFailure) throw new Error(captureFailure)`, and captureFailure is read nowhere else (grep: lines 117,127-130,190). If the stop request and the denial event land in the same 5 s iteration, the loop breaks without throwing; the finally block still runs settleDeniedCapture (status failed, zero-byte file removed) but runRecord proceeds to finalize as a normal stop. The same ordering already applies to admission_timeout, so it is a pre-existing pattern. The reviewer cited about line 143; the actual line is 190. Narrow window, no data loss.
fix_direction: after the loop (or in the stop branch) throw captureFailure when set and no media exists; ledger only, never a unit by itself.
